tools.name: compare_with
tools.description: How Argos compares to another visual testing tool: feature-by-feature table, prices at sample volumes where the competitor publishes them, migration guide, and FAQ.

competitor.description: The tool to compare Argos with. 'playwright' means Playwright's built-in toHaveScreenshot().

tools.name: estimate_monthly_cost
tools.description: Estimate what Argos costs per month for a given usage: screenshots, Storybook screenshots, media uploads (images and videos), and the GitHub SSO or SAML SSO add-ons. Uses the same arithmetic as the pricing page.

screenshots.description: Screenshots uploaded per month from Playwright, Cypress, Vitest, or any non-Storybook SDK or the CLI.

storybookScreenshots.description: Storybook screenshots uploaded per month (billed at a lower rate).

mediaImages.description: Standalone images uploaded per month through media sharing.

mediaVideos.description: Standalone videos uploaded per month through media sharing.

githubSso.description: Add the GitHub Single Sign-On add-on.

tools.name: get_argos_overview
tools.description: What Argos is: four things it does for every pull request, Diff (screenshots and any text file, not just pixels), Review (humans and agents approve what changed), Stabilize (flaky-test history and debugging) and Deploy (free preview URLs for Storybook and static sites), plus a map of every page, doc, API and agent surface. Start here.

tools.name: get_docs_page
tools.description: Read one Argos documentation page as markdown. Pass the path from search_docs or a docs URL, e.g. 'quickstart/playwright-quickstart' or https://argos-ci.com/docs/learn/review-workflow. An empty path returns the documentation index.

path.description: Docs path without the /docs prefix, or a full docs URL.

tools.name: get_latest_changelog
tools.description: Recent Argos product updates and new features (the changelog), most recent first, as markdown. Read one entry in full with get_page.

tools.name: get_mcp_connection_info
tools.description: How to connect an AI agent to Argos itself: the MCP server endpoint, OAuth and personal access token authentication, and the REST API endpoints.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read an argos-ci.com page as markdown, by path or full URL. Pages: /, /deploy, /diff, /review, /stabilize, /ai-agents, /media-sharing, /pricing, /security, /compare/applitools, /compare/backstopjs, /compare/chromatic, /compare/percy, /compare/playwright, /dpa, /privacy, /terms, /blog/<slug>, /changelog/<slug>. Documentation paths (/docs/...) work too.

path.description: Page path such as /pricing or /blog/<slug>, or a full https://argos-ci.com URL.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Argos plans and prices: Hobby (free), Pro (flat monthly price plus per-screenshot overage), Enterprise, add-ons, what counts as a screenshot, and the pricing FAQ. Use estimate_monthly_cost to price a specific usage.

tools.name: get_quickstart
tools.description: Step-by-step guide to set up Argos with a test framework: install the SDK, capture screenshots, run it in CI. Use 'other' for any framework not listed (upload screenshots with the Argos CLI).

framework.description: The test framework to set up Argos with.

tools.name: get_security_compliance
tools.description: Argos security and compliance: SOC 2 Type II (auditor, report access), GDPR, data location and encryption, access controls, open source, responsible disclosure, and the security FAQ.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Current operational status of the Argos service (live, from the status page).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Argos documentation (setup guides, SDK references, CI integrations, review workflow, flaky tests, API, agents) and get the matching pages with their URLs. Follow up with get_docs_page.
